item.title: Analyst Says the Worst Month for Stocks Since 1950 Is Setting Up Wrong This Year | 分析师表示，自1950年以来股市最糟糕的一个月今年出现了错误
item.description:
September has buried more portfolios than any other month since 1950, but one strategist says the traders treating this year like every other year are making a costly assumption about what actually drives those losses.
自1950年以来， 9月份的投资组合比其他任何一个月都要多，但一位策略师表示，像对待其他年份一样对待今年的交易员对实际造成这些损失的原因做出了代价高昂的假设。
